people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.
translations.bsb: He sent messengers on ahead, who went into a village of the Samaritans to make arrangements for Him.
translations.kjv: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
